scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dfragon/lib build && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".test-dist/test/**/*.test.js"
